infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CampusFlow uses the camera to read the QR anchors printed in campus corridors, which fixes your indoor position.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CampusFlow uses your location to guide you to the campus outdoors.

plugins.cameraPermission: CampusFlow reads the QR anchors on campus walls to place you indoors.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: CampusFlow guides you to your institution outdoors.
